title: SB1176 (2026 Regular Session): Modifies provisions relating to firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.023 (RSMo): No person, corporation, or other entity in the state of Missouri shall manufacture, import, possess, purchase, sell, or transfer any assault weapon or large capacity magazine.
Section 571.023 (RSMo): 3. The provisions of this section shall not apply to: (1) Any government officer, agent, or employee; member of the United States Armed Forces; or peace officer, to the extent that the person is authorized to acquire or possess an assault weapon or large capacity magazine and does so while acting within the scope of his or her duties; (4) Any person who, prior to and continuously since the effective date of this section, was legally in possession of an assault weapon or large capacity magazine.
Section 571.023 (RSMo): 4. A violation of this section is a class C felony.
Section 571.070 (RSMo): (2) Such person is a fugitive from justice, is habitually in an intoxicated or drugged condition, or is currently adjudged mentally incompetent or has been committed to any state mental institution at sixteen years of age or older.
Section 571.080 (RSMo): A person commits the offense of transfer of a concealable firearm if such person violates 18 U.S.C. Section 922(b), 18 U.S.C. Section 922(t), or 18 U.S.C. Section 922(x).
